Add a new section to INSTALL.md documenting the one-time admin setup for GitHub Rulesets targeting session-* branches. This is a documentation task (no executable code changes), but it must be precise and correct.

Section to add: '## GitHub Rulesets for session-* branches' (or under an existing '## PR-Mode Projects' section as a subsection)

Content requirements:
- Prerequisite: admin:write permission on the repository (one-time setup); runtime CI does NOT require admin
- Explain purpose: Rulesets on session-* branches reject direct pushes, enforcing the sub-branch-to-session PR flow
- Provide gh api commands (or UI steps) to create a Ruleset targeting refs/heads/session/* with:
  - required_status_checks: containing the check name from dso.review.check_name (Sprint Story Review by default)
  - required_linear_history: false
  - direct push restriction (non_fast_forward rule)
- Provide a gh api GET command to verify the Ruleset exists (what check-ruleset-preflight.sh checks)
- Note that check-ruleset-preflight.sh (called by Sprint Phase A in ci-pr mode) will validate this configuration before dispatch
- Note that check_name must match per-branch-review.yml name field and dso.review.check_name in dso-config.conf
- Link anchor: #github-rulesets-for-session-branches (used by check-ruleset-preflight.sh error output)

Placement: After the existing 'PR-Mode Projects' section in INSTALL.md (currently around line 73-93).
